tw-mi-eden-twp-noyes-gold-1935.st: Noyes himself told INS the sum was $25,000, 'not $80,000 or $85,000'; later briefs still gave $85,000 and no result.
tw-mi-eden-twp-noyes-gold-1935.t: Name (Fred/Frank) and amount ($25,000 vs $85,000) differ between wire services; the card follows the Mason County record (Fred S.).
